mapper.sql: t.id, t.project_id, t.user_id, t.apply_time, t.status, t.remark, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, p.project_name AS project_name

FROM volunteer_enrollment t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN volunteer_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_enrollment (project_id, user_id, apply_time, status, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{applyTime}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_enrollment SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM volunteer_enrollment t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status
